facts.title: Why is Samson's story even in the Bible?

items.msg: first VO line equals the title
'secret' — make sure the text really says this: 'Then came Delilah. She tried to hand him over three times, and he still told her'
'all' — make sure the text really says this: 'Blinded, the man born to fight the Philistines was brought out to entertain them'
'only' — make sure the text really says this: 'Samson could only begin. On the cross, Jesus said, "It is finished."'

answer stated in the Turn/Landing: 'He began Israel's rescue, and he needed rescuing himself.
